+    def get_locally_reachable_ips(self, ip_path):
+        reachable = {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}
+        if not ip_path:
+            self.module.warn('Unable to collect locally reachable IPs: ip command not found')
+            return reachable
+
+        for family, flag, version in (('ipv4', '-4', 4), ('ipv6', '-6', 6)):
+            if version == 6 and not socket.has_ipv6:
+                continue
+
+            # IPv6 local routes do not always print "scope host", so select
+            # their route type. IPv4 can also have host-scope routes without
+            # the explicit "local" type.
+            selector = ['scope', 'host'] if version == 4 else ['type', 'local']
+            command = [ip_path, flag, 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all'] + selector
+            try:
+                rc, output, _ = self.module.run_command(command, errors='surrogate_then_replace')
+            except OSError as e:
+                self.module.warn('Unable to collect locally reachable IPv%s routes: %s' % (version, e))
+                continue
+            if rc != 0:
+                self.module.warn('Unable to collect locally reachable IPv%s routes (ip exited %s)' % (version, rc))
+                continue
+
+            networks = set()
+            for line in output.splitlines():
+                words = line.split()
+                if not words:
+                    continue
+                if words[0] == 'local' and len(words) > 1:
+                    destination = words[1]
+                elif version == 4 and 'scope host' in line:
+                    destination = words[1] if words[0] == 'unicast' and len(words) > 1 else words[0]
+                else:
+                    continue
+                if destination == 'default':
+                    destination = '0.0.0.0/0' if version == 4 else '::/0'
+                else:
+                    address, slash, prefix = destination.partition('/')
+                    destination = address.split('%', 1)[0] + (slash + prefix if slash else '')
+                try:
+                    network = ipaddress.ip_network(destination, strict=False)
+                except ValueError:
+                    continue
+                if network.version == version:
+                    networks.add(network)
+
+            for network in sorted(networks, key=lambda value: (int(value.network_address), value.prefixlen)):
+                reachable[family].append(str(network.network_address) if network.prefixlen == network.max_prefixlen else str(network))
+
+        return reachable
+

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_normalizes_local_routes():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '''\
+192.168.1.7/24 dev lo table 100 scope host
+local 127.0.0.1/32 dev lo table local scope host
+local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo table local scope host
+local 192.168.0.1 dev lo table local scope host
+local 192.168.0.1/32 dev lo table local scope host
+broadcast 192.168.0.255 dev eth0 table local scope link
+192.0.2.0/24 dev eth0 scope link
+local invalid dev lo table local scope host
+local 2001:db8::1 dev lo table local scope host
+''', ''),
+        (0, '''\
+local fe80::1%eth0 dev eth0 table local
+local 2001:db8:abcd::1/64 dev lo table 100
+local ::1 dev lo table local proto kernel
+local 2001:0db8:0:0:0:0:0:1/128 dev lo table local
+local fe80::1%eth1 dev eth1 table local
+''', ''),
+    ]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::1', '2001:db8:abcd::/64', 'fe80::1'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list == [
+        ((['/usr/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'scope', 'host'],), {'errors': 'surrogate_then_replace'}),
+        ((['/usr/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'all', 'type', 'local'],), {'errors': 'surrogate_then_replace'}),
+    ]
+    module.warn.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_continues_after_failed_family():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(1, '', 'unsupported'), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', '')]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to collect locally reachable IPv4 routes (ip exited 1)')
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_handles_missing_ip_and_ipv6():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).populate() == {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to collect locally reachable IPs: ip command not found')
+    module.run_command.assert_not_called()
+
+    module.reset_mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo\n', '')
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False):
+        assert LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/usr/sbin/ip') == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 1
+    module.warn.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_populate_exposes_locally_reachable_ips_with_existing_facts():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/usr/sbin/ip'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [(0, 'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo\n', ''), (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', '')]
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    interfaces = {'lo': {'device': 'lo'}}
+    ips = {'all_ipv4_addresses': ['192.0.2.1'], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_default_interfaces', return_value=({'interface': 'lo'}, {})), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_interfaces_info', return_value=(interfaces, ips)):
+        result = network.populate()
+
+    assert result['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert result['all_ipv4_addresses'] == ['192.0.2.1']
+    assert result['lo'] == {'device': 'lo'}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector().fact_ids
